hypotheses.claim: On cvrp_dev_hetero_24 the weakest regimes are tight capacity (12 instances, vbs_rel_gap -23.60%), size=100 (-22.47%) and uniform demands (-22.49%), where removal by pure distance savings leaves routes near capacity that Regret-2 cannot refill feasibly. Therefore a hook that scores ruin candidates as removal_savings normalized by route_dists blended with demand saturation (demands/capacity) and that gradually shifts weight toward high-saturation nodes as stagnation_ratio grows will reduce mean objective below the current SBS 15.7435 while keeping solve_ms_mean under 500 ms.

next_search_advice.direction: Capacity-aware ruin scoring: reweight removal_savings by per-node demand fill (demands/capacity) and switch to stagnation-driven diversification when stagnation_ratio is high, targeting the weakest regimes (capacity_level=tight, size=100, demand_dist=uniform).
